title: PyTorch nightly fails on Windows with RTX 5080 (CUDA 13.0): missing torchaudio wheels + torchvision dependency conflict
bug_description: ### 🐛 Describe the bug ### System Info - OS: Windows 11 - GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080 - Driver: 581.80 - CUDA reported from nvidia-smi: 13.0 - Python: 3.11.8 - Environment: venv ### Summary PyTorch nightly fails to install correctly on Windows when using RTX 5080 (CUDA 13). The following issues occur: 1. `torchaudio` has **no available wheels** for Windows + Python 3.11 + CUDA 12.4/12.5/13. 2. `torchvision` nightly requires `torch==2.7.0.dev20250225+cu124`, but this torch version is **not available** for my environment. 3. Stable Diffusion WebUI reports: `RuntimeError: Torch is not able to use GPU` 4. Only CPU mode works. ### Full Error Logs (from my installation) - ERROR: No matching distribution found for torchaudio - ERROR: Cannot install torch and torchvision because these package versions have conflicting dependencies - torch==2.7.0.dev+cu124 not found for Python 3.11 - GPU is not recognized even though nvidia-smi reports CUDA 13.0 ### Additional Info nvidia-smi output: CUDA Version: 13.0 Driver Version: 581.80 GPU: GeForce RTX 5080 ### Expected - Provide Windows wheels for torch / torchvision / torchaudio that support CUDA 13 and new RTX 50-series GPUs. - Provide compatible nightly builds for Python 3.11 or documented support status. Thank you! 1.This screenshot shows that torch, torchvision, and torchaudio cannot be installed on Windows + Python 3.11 + CUDA 13.0 (RTX 5080). Torch wheels for this environment do not exist. 2.This screenshot shows a dependency conflict: torchvision requires torch 2.7.0.dev but this torch build does not exist for Python 3.11/CUDA 13/Windows. 3.nvidia-smi shows that the system is running CUDA 13.0 on an RTX 5080. PyTorch currently supports up to CUDA 12.4, so CUDA 13 and RTX 5080 have no compatible wheels. 4.Stable Diffusion WebUI only detects torch+cu121 (CPU-only mode). GPU is not used because no compatible CUDA wheel exists for RTX 5080. 5.This screenshot shows the WebUI failing to fetch its model assets due to failed torch installation, causing the WebUI initialization to stop. 6.PowerShell blocked Activate.ps1 due to execution policy. This was fixed with: Set-ExecutionPolicy -Scope Process -ExecutionPolicy Bypass ### Versions Please let me know if you need further diagnostics, environment logs, or additional testing. I am willing to provide any extra information that might help reproduce or resolve the issue. Thank you for your continued work and support for the PyTorch community. cc @seemethere @malfet @atalman @tinglvv
